# Copilot Review Rules

- Conduct a SINGLE, absolute, thorough review pass.
- Identify all critical, architectural, stylistic, and security bugs simultaneously in the first iteration.
- DO NOT save minor feedback for future commit rounds. If an issue is present, comment on it immediately.
- Once a fix is pushed, your ONLY job is to verify if the previous comment was addressed. Do not generate net-new comments on unchanged code or previously skipped lines.
